headline: Steady growth and wider margins, guidance reconfirmed
summary_short: AstraZeneca Q3 total revenue was $16.2B, up 7% at constant currency, with Core EPS of $2.79 up 17% and core operating margin at 36%.
summary_long: Product revenue grew 7%, with double-digit growth in Oncology, R&I and Rare Disease offsetting Farxiga headwinds over nine months. Gross margin was 82% on positive product mix, partly offset by pricing headwinds. Other operating income rose on partner milestones and the Zoryve interest disposal. Core R&D was 22% of revenue. The company reconfirmed FY2026 guidance: mid-to-high single-digit revenue growth and low double-digit Core EPS growth. It also launched a restructuring programme costing up to $2.0B.
confidence_notes: Quarter figures from Table 2 of the 9M and Q3 2026 release. Core measures are non-IFRS. Growth rates quoted at actual and constant exchange rates as stated; revenue delta is CER (7% actual also).

drivers.explanation: Product revenue rose 7%; the release cites double-digit growth in Oncology, R&I and Rare Disease for the nine months, offsetting Farxiga headwinds.
Gross margin gained 1ppt on positive product mix, partly offset by pricing headwinds including loss of exclusivity and VBP in China; other operating income rose on milestones and the Zoryve disposal.
Reflects the operating profit growth; net finance expense rose on lower interest income and higher borrowing costs.
Management cites strong commercial momentum, four new medicine approvals and 12 positive Phase III readouts.
